docs_corpus.why: DwC-A profile: occurrence core + extensions + meta.xml
OBIS Event Core + DNA-derived data + eMoF/OBIS-ENV-DATA pattern
online validator POST endpoint (/v1 validation API)
reference only — GBIF leg wraps the eDNAbridge path conceptually; our runnable code is the Python DwC-A builder

hard_gates.a_signoff: flagged_occurrences.tsv rows with signoff_status == 'pending' are hard-blocked from publish; publish aborts with a report until every row is approved/excluded (PLAN §11.4)
hard_gates.b_obis_realm: obis-publish refuses with a clear message when realm != 'marine' (OBIS does not accept terrestrial/freshwater datasets)
hard_gates.c_worms_lsid: obis-publish hard-rejects any record without a WoRMS-valid scientificNameID (urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:N)

input_contracts.enriched_parquet: PLAN §11.2 — one row = taxon x site x record; scientificName, acceptedScientificName, gbif_taxonKey, worms_AphiaID, taxon_match_status, env_* columns, qc_flags, qc_level, realm
input_contracts.flagged_occurrences_tsv: PLAN §11.4 — §11.2 columns + signoff_status in {pending, approved, excluded}; pending hard-blocked
input_contracts.run_manifest: PLAN §11.1 params.json of the edna-crosscheck run; realm is dataset-level

output_contracts.gbif_dwca: *_gbif_dwca.zip (occurrence core + DNA-derived data extension + meta.xml + EML 2.0)
output_contracts.obis_dwca: *_obis_dwca.zip (Event Core hierarchy + occurrence ext + DNA-derived data ext + eMoF/OBIS-ENV-DATA; marine only)
output_contracts.publish_commands: publish_commands.sh — ready-to-run IPT/eDNAbridge/OBIS-ipt commands the user executes; NO live publishing calls from this skill in v1

network_policy: read-only network calls allowed (GBIF validator POST, docs fetches); no live IPT/OBIS publish calls
